premise: I'm the best hacker in Night City. Corporations pay fortunes to keep me out of their systems.

draft.premise: I'm the best hacker in Night City. Corporations pay fortunes to keep me out of their systems.

world.title: Cybernetic Horizon
world.era: Night City, 2077: cybernetic implants, flying vehicles, and lethal corporate intranets

extraordinary.reach: Full-body conversion, neural integration, and sensory enhancement.
Direct mental interface with global networks, lethal digital defense programs, and mind-rewriting.

rules.text: Netrunning directly exposes a hacker's brain to lethal feedback loops and Black ICE programs.
Pushing past human neural limits with excessive cybernetics risks mental collapse and cyberpsychosis.
Megacorporations operate entirely above local law inside their designated physical and digital territories.
Data and messages travel instantly across the global Net, making physical isolation the only true privacy.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: A highly stratified global urban population surviving under corporate hegemony.

nature: Light pollution permanently obscures the stars in metropolitan areas.
Acid rain regularly sweeps across coastal areas due to centuries of industrial waste.

rungs.name: Script Kid
rungs.description: Relies entirely on pre-written tools and basic exploits.

rungs.name: Code Jockey
rungs.description: Can write basic custom scripts and breach low-security networks.

rungs.name: Sysop
rungs.description: Maintains and secures local enterprise intranets.

rungs.name: Glitcher
rungs.description: Experienced freelance hacker known for disrupting local grid sectors.

rungs.name: Netrunner
rungs.description: A professional capable of breaching mid-tier corporate systems.

rungs.name: Elite Runner
rungs.description: A high-tier infiltrator feared by corporate security teams.

rungs.name: Legend of the Net
rungs.description: A mythical phantom who treats megacorp mainframes like personal playgrounds.

travel.description: Hyper-trains, armored sedans, and flying AVs route between fortified sectors.

medicine.healing: Nanite injections, bio-monitoring implants, and rapid cybernetic limb replacement.
medicine.resurrection_means: Uploading a brain's digital copy (soulkiller architecture) into a blank cybernetic shell.

laws.text: Unauthorized intrusion into corporate servers is punishable by immediate neural fry or terminal physical arrest.

places.name: Night City
places.description: A sprawling, rain-slicked metropolis dominated by towering neon billboards and massive corporate monoliths.

places.name: Watson District
places.description: A crowded, dangerous sector filled with neon-lit alleyways, street markets, and packed apartment blocks.

places.name: Zero's Breach Nest
places.description: A dimly lit room filled with humming server racks, cold pizza boxes, and high-end neural link cradles.

places.name: City Center
places.description: The sparkling, pristine heart of corporate power where megastructures pierce the toxic clouds.

places.name: Arasaka Tower
places.description: A massive, black-glass fortress of corporate defense and state-of-the-art cyber-security.

factions.name: Arasaka Corporation
factions.description: A mega-conglomerate specializing in corporate security, banking, and defense systems.
factions.goal: To capture or neutralize the elite runner breaching their high-priority servers.
factions.methods: Deploying physical strike teams and hunting through advanced net-tracking algorithms.
factions.strength: Limitless wealth, private military forces, and military-grade Black ICE.

factions.name: Netwatch
factions.description: The online police force tasked with keeping the Net safe from rogue AIs and high-tier hackers.
factions.goal: To maintain the Blackwall and arrest unauthorized Netrunners.
factions.methods: Monitoring public and private nodes, and tracing neural signatures.
factions.strength: Advanced intrusion counter-measures and global digital jurisdiction.

npcs.name: Vance
npcs.description: A seasoned street fixer who handles elite black-market tech contracts.
npcs.appearance: Sharp synthetic suit, a cybernetic gold tooth, and glowing blue opti-eyes.

wants: To broker the ultimate corporate data heist without getting killed.
temperament.voice: Low-pitched, gravelly, and fast-talking street slang.

agenda.goal: Broker a buyout for Zero's silence to save his own skin.
agenda.method: Set up a secret meeting with an Arasaka handler.

npcs.name: Cipher
npcs.description: An ambitious netrunner who switches between your closest rival and your shadow accomplice.
npcs.appearance: Rebellious pink cyber-hair, quick-release tactical wear, and digital tattoos pulsing along her arms.

fears: having her brain fried by Netwatch
wants: To surpass Zero and claim the title of the best hacker in Night City.
temperament.voice: Sarcastic, rapid-fire, and laced with technical jargon.

npcs.name: Director Saito
npcs.description: The cold, calculative chief of Arasaka's Counter-Intrusion branch.
npcs.appearance: Flawless corporate suit, cybernetic cheekplates, and unblinking chrome-ringed eyes.

wants: To permanently eliminate the netrunner known as 'Zero'.
temperament.voice: Measured, devoid of emotion, and chillingly polite.

agenda.goal: Execute a terminal trace on Zero and deploy a physical tactical team to eliminate the threat.
agenda.method: Use a modified, military-grade Black ICE virus.

clocks.name: Arasaka Trace and Purge
steps: Arasaka launches a global node sweep looking for your signature.
Local subnet nodes in Watson are shut down as Arasaka narrows the search.
An elite Arasaka counter-hacker locks your neural connection.
A heavily armed corporate strike team breaches your hideout door.

threads.title: Outrunning the Corporate Eye
threads.stakes: If Arasaka finishes their digital sweep, Zero will be physically hunted and digitally fried.

mysteries.question: What is Arasaka's classified project 'Soulcatcher'?
mysteries.answer: Arasaka is building a digital prison to upload the conscious minds of elite netrunners, trapping them to serve as permanent security constructs.
clues: Encrypted project logs referencing 'neural extraction rates'.
A ghost subnet that only accepts brainwave signatures matching dead Netrunners.
A warning note from an anonymous whistleblower about 'mind-uploading initiatives'.

known_facts: You are currently targeted by Arasaka's best tracking software.
Vance is brokering corporate security protocols but might sell your location if the price is right.
The city center is heavily monitored by Netwatch.

opening.situation: You sit in the neon shadow of your Watson hideout, screens flashing crimson as your latest successful intrusion into Arasaka's servers triggers a lethal system-wide trace.

world.summary: You are the best hacker in Night City, paid fortunes by corporations to test their security or keep out of their systems. Now, Arasaka's counter-intel division is hot on your trail, and the countdown to your physical trace has begun.

character.name: Zero
character.description: A pale, incredibly focused specialist who speaks in short, precise bursts and exists mostly inside digital space.
character.appearance: Sleek, glowing chrome neural ports along the neck, reflective cybernetic eyes that pulse with data, and dark, oversized techwear hoodie hiding a lean frame.

skills.name: Hacking
skills.notes: Unmatched speed and intuition with raw code.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.notes: Expert at avoiding both camera sweeps and physical sentries.

skills.name: Electronics
skills.notes: Quick with rewiring panels and bypassing physical locks.

skills.name: Handguns
skills.notes: Basic training in case the street gets too loud.

traits.name: Neural Interface Pro
traits.description: Plugs directly into the net with significantly higher data-transfer speeds.

traits.name: Cyber-Addiction
traits.description: Suffers physical shaking and severe headaches if disconnected from the Net for too long.

talents.name: The Sword of Code
talents.covers: any program or code intrusion technique you watch another netrunner perform.
talents.reason: Possesses a highly advanced, copycat-optimized ocular implant.

powers.name: Neural Overheat
limits: Requires a line of sight or an active local subnet connection to the target.

costs.text: Causes mild neural fatigue and a brief cooldown of 10 seconds.

techniques.name: Glitch Shift
techniques.effect: Temporarily blinds all nearby optical cybernetics and cameras for five seconds.

loves: the quiet hum of a server room
wants: Maintain supremacy over the Net and keep corporate hands off your freedom.

items.name: Legendary Cyberdeck (Militech Sovereign)
items.description: A top-of-the-line neural deck modified with experimental cooling.

items.name: Smart Pistol (Arasaka Yukimura)
items.description: A compact smart-linked pistol with target tracking.

connections.name: Cipher
connections.note: A highly skilled rival who keeps you on your toes.

connections.name: Vance
connections.note: Your primary source of high-paying corporate bounties.

backstory: Raised in the neon-soaked lower-slums, you taught yourself how to program using discarded corp tablets.
At age twenty, you pulled off your first major heist against a Militech research laboratory, earning your reputation.
Since then, your name has become a whispered ghost story in boardrooms, with corporations paying fortunes just to secure their nodes against you.
